notes.title: New Play Method: Daily Sea Battle!
notes.notes:
Commander!
The game has now installed a new mode: Daily Naval Battle (Test Version). You can enter the experience by clicking the button on the top left of the game!
This mode is a third person ship shooting game,
Players can personally experience launching artillery shells and bombarding enemy ships! Dealing with the enemy in a hail of bullets! You can also obtain random Level B skill fragments * 100 if you win a battle.
This gameplay is only a trial version, and there are many areas that need to be improved. If commanders have any suggestions for improving the gameplay, please leave a message~
You can also join our QQ group to discuss: 588921856

notes.title: Talk to developers
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,  I am Qiqi from the publicity and development department of "Blue Star Ship strategy".  I represent more than 30 people of the developer team to say a few words for you. 
  
Thanks a lot for your attention to the expectations of "Blue Star Ship strategy" all the time.Our production team, lovers of modern times of history and the navy, came together by chance. I like to design my imaginary battleships and naval battles very much. I want to explore how different eras of battleships will conflict if they meet across time and space. So we decided to make an SRPG that included fleets growing, and let players change their lives in a parallel universe.  We want to let our warships sail far and wide, and let everyone realizes that China is not short of warship enthusiasts. Thus we've done it in the most realistic models and historical way as hardly as we can. Let the world know that this is a naval battle game from China, the great Empire!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42142735/c4cac51812776079570ba54fb64d84f55d9452e6.jpg[/img]

 "Blue Star Ship strategy" is not only naval battle, but also to mix the needs of present players’  game types, increasing the strategy, management, cultivation and collection and so on. The thing we want to do is let the players find their own game preference, and continue to explore the new thing they haven’t played before. 
 
In modeling of this game, we simulate the battleships from The first World War, each warship and submarine has its own manufacturing timeline and origin introduction;  In terms of character’s modeling, according to naval officers of different countries, we make similar commander roles in “Blue Star Ship strategy” , and decorate their costumes and the colors of hair to make the symbol of the country vividly, try our best to restore the real historical naval world to players.  
 
When some players play similar naval warfare games, due to time and place limitations, many players can not enjoy the PC game, resulting in lagging behind other players;  Some mobile players also feel that they don't enjoy the rich atmosphere of naval battle when they play in the small screen for a long time... In a word, we team have noticed the demand of naval battle players, So it is available on a mobile phone with the same name "Blue Star Ship strategy". "Blue Star Ship strategy" solved the player's time and place limitation, allowing players complete some time-consuming part in pieces of time. In your spare time, you can focus on conquering cities and territories on Steam...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42142735/424d8336afc3ce4b79440d8fd6f33a8c237ec665.png[/img]

The team of developers, like you, are all passionate gamers of naval warfare, although we invest a lot of energy on the "Blue Star Ship strategy", we still know that the "Blue Star Ship strategy" has many issues to updated and change in contents and the system. We deeply hope you can give some feedbacks, opinions and suggestions to us so, that we can improve it before launch.
 
Last but not least, We are welcome you to leave comments in the comments section below, and sincerely invite you to join the official QQ group 588921856 to contact with the developers. “Blue Star Ship strategy” will be better and better because of you
